snippet.title: These Starless Skies - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A discordant team of planetary scientists must confront their personal demons and unravel the enigma of a mysterious tidally-locked planet, all before their inner chaos takes over in this 2.5D sci-fi point and click adventure.

Currently in development by Wayward Astronaut in Perth, Western Australia, with the assistance of Screen Australia and Screenwest.

Website: https://thesestarlessskies.com/
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3253090/These_Starless_Skies/
